name: print-social-cinecar-outdoors-drive-in-posts-black-pink-yellow-triangle
title: 'Cinecar Outdoors' drive-in cinema pack in black with pink-yellow-blue triangle blocks and popcorn illustration
whatItIs: Nine black square posts with angular pink, yellow and blue triangle colour blocks, a yellow bean-shaped 'Cinecar Outdoors' logo, illustrated popcorn and a car silhouette, headlines ('2x1 Movies Every Monday', 'Book your ticket now', 'Live the movie experience in your car') and film-reel icons.
whatItMeans: Bold and playful; sharp triangle colour blocks give a retro drive-in concept a modern graphic edge.
techniques: Cut backgrounds with angular triangle colour blocks.
Use a bean-shaped logo badge for a friendly, rounded brand mark.
Repeat popcorn and car icons as recurring thematic props.

vocabulary.definition: An angular flat shape used to divide a background.
A rounded, organic label shape for a logo.
